title: Planned live demo at Electrostatic Society of America conference
summary: Charles Buer tells of Planned live demo at Electrostatic Society of America conference, about June (year of recording) at Cocoa Beach, Florida, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: my lab is um that's in Cocoa Beach Florida and I will do a live demo of this.

plain: Charles Buer, a scientist presented on Jesse Michels's podcast as a former NASA figure who claims to have built an antigravity drive, says he planned a live demonstration of it at a conference of the Electrostatic Society of America, a group of scientists who study static electricity. He says his lab is in Cocoa Beach, Florida, and that he will show the device working in public, which would matter because it would put the claim in front of other experts.
